title: Agents API token usage rises after 2026-10-30 because context compaction now runs in the background
symptoms: Token bills for Agents API sessions went up with no code change
Compaction no longer blocks a turn but extra tokens show in usage
cause: On 2026-10-30 the Agents API changed the default so context compaction runs in the background. Background compaction can use more tokens than the earlier blocking behavior.
fix: If you need the earlier blocking behavior or want predictable token usage, set compaction.async to false in the agent configuration.
affected: Agents API public beta, default changed 2026-10-30
